# paddle_subscriptions (Data Source)

List every Paddle subscription matching `customer_id`/`status` filters — the plural companion to `paddle_subscription` (which requires exactly one match). Leave both filters unset to list every subscription in the account. See [Paddle API Reference](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/subscriptions/overview).

**⚠️ An unfiltered (or loosely filtered) call to this data source lists every matching subscription in the account, one API call per page of results — a real cost against a large account, and a large `subscriptions` list written into your Terraform state file on every `plan`/`refresh`.** Narrow with `customer_id`/`status` where practical.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "paddle_subscriptions" "example" {
  # Filter by owning customer
  customer_id = "ctm_..." # replace with a real customer ID

  # Optionally narrow further by status:
  # status = "active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `customer_id` (String) Filter by the owning customer's ID (prefix `ctm_...`). Leave unset to match subscriptions for any customer.
- `status` (String) Filter by status: one of `active`, `canceled`, `past_due`, `paused`, `trialing`. Leave unset to match any status.

### Read-Only

- `subscriptions` (Attributes List) Matching subscriptions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions))

<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 date-time this subscription was created, set by Paddle.
- `currency_code` (String) ISO 4217 code for this subscription's primary currency.
- `customer_id` (String) Paddle customer ID (prefix `ctm_...`) owning this subscription.
- `id` (String) Paddle subscription ID (prefix `sub_...`).
- `next_billed_at` (String) RFC 3339 date-time of the next scheduled billing, or `null` if there isn't one.
- `status` (String) One of `active`, `canceled`, `past_due`, `paused`, `trialing`.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 date-time this subscription was last updated, set by Paddle.
